targets.recordKey: entity["gen_withdrawalid"] = Row.GenwithdrawalId (primary-key attribute; entity.Id is not set). Gen_withdrawalId = trans.Gen_withdrawalId = Gen_withdrawal.Gen_withdrawalid from the source query 'get open withdrawal' on [CRM] (psql / altshuler_mscrm). How CRM.Proxy builds the UpdateRequest from this attribute is inside the external assembly CRM.Proxy (not supplied, external_unknown).
targets.writeCondition: Every row of 'get open withdrawal' is updated (no filter in the script). The source query selects withdrawals with gen_currentstate = 8 (unqualified column) that have at least one transaction in gen_ftcurrentyear (joined via Gen_customeraccount -> Gen_fundmain) whose Gen_fundtransactiontype has Gen_actionid = 54 and gen_transgrouptype = 5 and ft.gen_valuedate >= gen_datesenttothebank (unqualified column), AND (inner join) at least one gen_fluiditylayerspartition row with gen_feedbackstatus not in (5,6). Runs after 'Create ETL Process record' succeeds (precedence Success).
targets.expression: new OptionSetValue(currentstate) where: int currentstate = 14 (comment 'הסתיים חלקית'); if (Row.minStatus == Row.maxStatus && Row.minStatus == 4) currentstate = 3 ('הסתיים'); then if ((!Row.genwithdrawaltype_IsNull && Row.genwithdrawaltype == 0) || (!Row.genwithdrawalfromfund_IsNull && Row.genwithdrawalfromfund == 0)) and Math.Truncate(Math.Abs(Row.gentranstotalamount)) != Math.Truncate(Math.Abs(Row.Genwithdrawalvalue)) -> currentstate = 15 ('הסתיים – קיים פער'; overrides both 14 and 3). Possible values 3 / 14 / 15 - computed from the inputs, not a single literal. Source SQL: minStatus = min(flp.gen_feedbackstatus), maxStatus = max(flp.gen_feedbackstatus) over gen_fluiditylayerspartition rows with gen_feedbackstatus not in (5,6); gen_withdrawaltype = min(flp.gen_withdrawaltype + 0); gen_withdrawalfromfund = min(flp.gen_withdrawalfromfund + 0); gen_transtotalamount = sum(ISNULL(gen_transtotalamount,0)) over the qualifying transactions (column unqualified); Gen_withdrawalvalue = ISNULL(Gen_withdrawalvalue, 0) (unqualified).

unresolved.where: Both 'get open withdrawal' queries: unqualified columns gen_currentstate, gen_datesenttothebank (automatic), gen_valuedate (manual WHERE), Gen_withdrawalvalue, gen_transtotalamount, gen_netoamountofaction
unresolved.reason: The SQL does not prefix these columns with a table alias; the owning table (Gen_withdrawal / Gen_customeraccount / Gen_fundmain / gen_ftcurrentyear / Gen_fundtransactiontype) is decided by the CRM database schema, which is not in scope. The CRM attribute values are proven only down to the SQL output columns.
External assembly not supplied (blocked_external_dependency): batching settings (ContinueOnError etc.) and how the Update request is built from entity["gen_withdrawalid"] cannot be verified.

notes.note: Writers in lineage (3): 2 business CRM writers mapped (5 attributes each, 10 total; gen_withdrawalid is the record key, not listed as an attribute). Excluded: End ETL Process record\ETL Record Finish (ETL plumbing), plus Create ETL Process record / Error ETL Process record script tasks (plumbing).

Manual flow: the SDK fault handling is missing - ExcecuteBulk only iterates successful responses (main.cs:76-85) and the Error output is never filled, so failed updates are silent. Automatic flow writes faults to ErrorBuffer (main.cs:85-90), but the Error output has no downstream path (only path is get open withdrawal -> close withdrawal), so they are also discarded.

Manual source SQL contains 'flp.gen_feedbackstatus ! =5' with a space (DTSX:2213). Behaviour assumed equal to '!=' (SQL Server tolerates whitespace in compound comparison operators) - not verified by execution.

Automatic flow: the 15 ('gap exists') rule overrides even the 14 ('partially finished') state, i.e. a withdrawal not fully reported by the bank can still get 15. The comparison uses Math.Truncate(Math.Abs(...)) on both amounts (integer part only), while gen_actualwithdrawalamount is written with sign and decimals.
Both scripts add rows to an in-memory list and flush every 1000 and at EndOfRowset; the automatic flow runs fully before the manual flow (precedence Success).
